A01.name: Rangitoto Island Summit Walk
bring: 1–2 litres of drinking water per person
Sturdy shoes for rough lava surfaces
Torch if visiting the lava caves
A01.tip: NO SHOPS OR DRINKING WATER ON THE ISLAND. Bring all food and water and check the last return ferry.
A01.backup: New Zealand Maritime Museum, Viaduct Harbour

A02.name: Maungakiekie / One Tree Hill and Cornwall Park
A02.mapQuery: Maungakiekie / One Tree Hill and Cornwall Park, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A02.tip: Carry water for the summit section. Cafés and facilities are in the park, not at the summit.
A02.backup: Te Whatu Stardome, One Tree Hill Domain

A03.name: Devonport Waterfront and Maungauika / North Head
A03.mapQuery: Devonport Waterfront and Maungauika / North Head, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A03.tip: The headland is exposed. Carry a windproof layer and water even when cafés are available in Devonport village.

A04.name: Beachlands to Maraetai Coastal Walkway
A04.start: Shelley Bay Toilet Reserve, end of Second View Avenue, Beachlands
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A04.tip: Bring a full water bottle. Refill points along the route were not confirmed. Unsealed sections can be muddy after rain.

A05.name: Auckland Coast-to-Coast Walkway
A05.start: Te Wero Bridge, Viaduct Basin (99 Customs Street West)
A05.mapQuery: Te Wero Bridge, Viaduct Harbour, Auckland
bring: Full water bottle with a refill plan
Charged phone, power bank and route map
Small first-aid kit and rubbish bag
A05.tip: Allow for a full walking day. Bring food and water rather than depending on every café being open.

A06.name: Auckland Domain & Wintergardens
A06.start: Domain Wintergardens, end of Wintergarden Road, Auckland Domain
A06.mapQuery: Domain Wintergardens, 20 Park Road, Grafton, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A06.tip: The glasshouses provide indoor space only while open. Carry a rain jacket for the outdoor park sections.

A07.name: Maungawhau / Mt Eden Summit Walk
A07.mapQuery: 250 Mount Eden Road, Mount Eden, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A07.tip: Carry water for the summit. Remain on formed paths and do not enter the sacred crater.
A07.backup: Westfield Newmarket, indoor browsing and food court

A08.name: Tāmaki Drive Waterfront Walk (Mission Bay & St Heliers)
A08.start: Ferry Building, corner of Queen Street and Quay Street, downtown
A08.mapQuery: Ferry Building, 99 Quay Street, Auckland CBD
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A08.tip: This is an exposed waterfront route. Bring water and sun/wind protection. Swim only if conditions are suitable.
A08.backup: SEA LIFE Kelly Tarlton’s Aquarium, Ōkahu Bay

A09.name: Parnell Farmers’ Market
A09.tip: Saturday market, 08:00–12:00. Check current pedestrian access because construction affects Jubilee Building access.

A10.name: Takapuna Beach & Sunday Market
A10.start: Waiwharariki Anzac Square, 38 Hurstmere Road, Takapuna
A10.mapQuery: Waiwharariki Anzac Square, 38 Hurstmere Road, Takapuna, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
Towel and swimwear only if swimming
A10.tip: Check the current Sunday market hours. Beach swimming is optional and requires a separate conditions check.

A11.name: Hobsonville Point Coastal Walkway
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A11.tip: Carry water and check return ferry times. The waterfront loop has no continuous covered shelter.
A11.backup: Catalina Bay Farmers Market, covered weekend market

A12.name: Ambury Regional Park Farm Walk
A12.mapQuery: Ambury Regional Park, Māngere Bridge, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
Closed-toe shoes suitable for a farm
A12.tip: BRING FOOD AND FILLED DRINKING WATER. Do not drink untreated campground tap water. Wash hands after animal contact and before eating.
A12.backup: Māngere Bridge Library, indoor reading and browsing

A13.name: Auckland Botanic Gardens (Manurewa)
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A13.tip: Bring water for the garden paths. Café service and the visitor centre have shorter hours than the outdoor gardens.
A13.backup: Huakaiwaka Visitor Centre, Auckland Botanic Gardens

A14.name: Western Springs Lakeside Park
A14.start: 731 Great North Road, Western Springs (enter from Great North Rd or Motions Rd)
A14.mapQuery: 731 Great North Road, Western Springs, Auckland
bring: Light rain jacket or warm layer
A14.tip: Do not feed the birds. Carry a rain jacket. Tree shade is not covered shelter.
A14.backup: Westfield St Lukes, indoor browsing and food court

A15.name: Ōtara Flea Market
A15.start: Car park behind Ōtara Town Centre, Ōtara
A15.mapQuery: Ōtara Town Centre, Newbury Street, Ōtara, Auckland
A15.tip: Saturday market, 06:00–12:00, except public holidays. Arrive before noon. Some nearby restaurants open only at 10:00 or 11:00.
A15.backup: Ōtara Library, indoor reading and browsing
